title: Source
description: A media source exposed by the host (api/openapi.yaml, 01 CON).

id.description: Stable id; appears in URLs and in `{id}||{dir}` form values.

capabilities.description: What the source lets clients change (01 CON-04, 11 MS-09). A field left out means allowed. Clients hide the controls for anything false; the server refuses it with 403.

location.description: Entries may carry `location` and the location filter qualifiers are live (01 CON-05).
